$comment: vmui Toolkit — the single source of truth for the menu-bar app.
Adding a tool means adding an entry here. No Swift changes required:
the app reads this file at launch and builds its menu from it.
IMPORTANT: `command` runs INSIDE the macOS guest, as the logged-in user.
The repo's scripts/mac-*.sh helpers SSH in from the host, so they cannot be
invoked from here. Guest-side logic lives in toolkit/tools/ and is installed
alongside the app; refer to it as $TOOLKIT/<name>.sh.
id          stable key, also used for the launchd label
section     groups items; sections render in first-seen order
command     argv array, executed without a shell unless you invoke one
confirm     ask before running (use for anything disruptive)
notify      post a user notification when it finishes
requires    capability gates; if unmet the item renders disabled with `unavailable`
unavailable why the item is greyed out (shown as a tooltip)
